what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria living in Germany.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 668647 Syrian refugees in Germany, 13.7% of all Syrian refugees.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria from 2011 to 2025, with Syrian insurgents, at war level from 2011 to 2020 and in 2023 and 2024.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2013 to 2025, and with the SDF in 2016, 2018 and from 2023 to 2025.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025, after big changes in each year from 2013 to 2016.
UNHCR's figure for Germany peaked at 725102 in 2024 and was 668647 at the end of 2025.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Germany only, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
Gender and age are known for only part of this group.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
